mapper.select: select user_id,UT_id,song_id,ST_id,play_count,last_play_time,source,action_type from music_db.user_behavior as ub left join song as s on s.song_id=ub.song_id left join user_tags as ut on ut.UT_id=ub.UT_id left join user as u on u.user_id=ub.user_id where ub.user_id=#{userId} and ub.UT_id=#{UTId} and ub.song_id=#{songId} and ub.ST_id=#{STId} order by last_play_time desc limit 20
